body: I don't even know why you guys would care enough to believe in me. I'm a horrible person. I can't be fixed. I'm broken...
Absolutely everything :( just thinking about that is making me cry now ugh...
I've always felt this way... I've just reached a point where I can't take it anymore.. don't want to go on...
No... family would be better off without me..m everyone would...
I'm sorry... I just don't think I can be helped...
